source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: ليلة العيد، البيت كان مليان حركة.
sentences.en: The night of Eid, the house was full of activity.

sentences.ar: إمي كانت تخبز كعك وتحضر الحلويات.
sentences.en: My mom was baking ka'ak and preparing the sweets.

sentences.ar: إحنا الولاد، كنا نساعد ونذوق سرا.
sentences.en: We kids used to help and taste secretly.

sentences.ar: أبوي جاب لكل واحد أواعي جديدة.
sentences.en: My dad brought each of us new clothes.

sentences.ar: الصبح، لبسنا الجديد ورحنا نسلم عالأهل.
sentences.en: In the morning, we wore the new clothes and went to greet the relatives.

sentences.ar: كل واحد كان يعطينا عيدية ومصاري.
sentences.en: Everyone would give us Eid gifts and money.

sentences.ar: بعدين، رحنا عالحديقة نلعب مع الولاد.
sentences.en: Then, we went to the garden to play with the kids.
In the evening, the whole family gathered for dinner.
It was the nicest night in the whole year.
